entry.title:
Meet you
at the harbor.
entry.controls:
BEFORE YOU DRIVE
Your keys to the harbor
W S
Throttle / brake
A D
Steer left / right
C
Change camera
B
Hold to look back
Esc
Pause / continue
R
Hold one second to restart
X
Forward / reverse

Use Tab and Enter for menus. Release driving controls when returning to the game. Restarting begins a new attempt.

Desktop first: a keyboard and a WebGL 2 browser are required. Touch driving is not supported. Standard gamepad bindings are available; physical controllers have not been certified.
